paras: Psomophis obtusus, also known commonly as the wide ground snake and corredeira-do-banhado in Brazilian Portuguese, is a species of snake in the subfamily Dipsadinae of the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to South America.
P. obtusus is found in Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay.
